intro: 三相电路就是三个频率相同、幅值相同、相位依次差 120° 的正弦电源同时供电的正弦稳态电路，分析方法仍然是相量法。**对称**时只算一相，其余两相按 120° 依次写出；**不对称**时老老实实用结点电压法（弥尔曼定理）和 KCL。本章相量一律取有效值，正序 A→B→C，以 U̇_A 为参考。

en.intro: A three-phase circuit is a sinusoidal steady-state circuit fed by three sources of equal frequency and amplitude, 120° apart — still solved with phasors. When it is **balanced**, compute one phase and write the other two by shifting 120°; when it is **unbalanced**, use nodal analysis (Millman's theorem) and KCL honestly. Phasors in this chapter are rms, the sequence is positive (A→B→C) and U̇_A is the reference.

ideas.title: 对称三相电源与相序
text: 对称三相电源：U̇_A = U_p∠0°，U̇_B = U_p∠−120°，U̇_C = U_p∠120°（正序 A→B→C）。三个相电压之和为零：U̇_A + U̇_B + U̇_C = 0——这是一相计算、中性点电压为零的根本原因。
**相电压**是每相电源（或负载）两端的电压，**线电压**是两根端线之间的电压，由 KVL：U̇_AB = U̇_A − U̇_B。

en.title: Balanced three-phase sources and phase sequence
text: A balanced three-phase source: U̇_A = U_p∠0°, U̇_B = U_p∠−120°, U̇_C = U_p∠120° (positive sequence A→B→C). The three phase voltages add up to zero: U̇_A + U̇_B + U̇_C = 0 — the root reason why one-phase calculation works and why the neutral-point voltage vanishes.
A **phase voltage** is the voltage across one phase of the source (or load); a **line voltage** is the voltage between two lines; by KVL, U̇_AB = U̇_A − U̇_B.

ideas.title: 星形（Y）连接：线电压与相电压
text: Y 连接时线电流就是相电流。对称时线电压是相电压的 √3 倍，并且**超前**对应的相电压 30°：U̇_AB = √3U̇_A∠30°。
我国低压配电：相电压 220 V，线电压 380 V。题目说“线电压 380 V”时，相电压是 380/√3 ≈ 219.4 V。

en.title: Star (Y) connection: line and phase voltages
text: In a Y connection the line current is the phase current. When balanced, the line voltage is √3 times the phase voltage and **leads** the corresponding phase voltage by 30°: U̇_AB = √3U̇_A∠30°.
Low-voltage mains in China: 220 V phase, 380 V line. When a problem says “line voltage 380 V”, the phase voltage is 380/√3 ≈ 219.4 V.

ideas.title: 对称 Y–Y 电路：归结为一相计算
text: 电源和负载都对称时（端线阻抗也相同），以 N 为参考对 N' 列结点方程，分子是 (U̇_A + U̇_B + U̇_C)/(Z_l + Z) = 0，所以 **U̇_{N'N} = 0**——有没有中线都一样，中线电流为零。
于是把 N、N' 用短路线连起来，只画 A 相：U̇_A、Z_l、Z 串联，İ_A = U̇_A/(Z_l + Z)。B、C 两相的电流、电压依次滞后 120°，不必再算。
负载端的相电压仍然对称，所以负载端线电压 = √3 × 负载相电压（但比电源线电压小，因为端线上有压降）。

en.title: Balanced Y–Y circuits: reduce to one phase
text: With balanced sources and loads (and equal line impedances), the nodal equation for N' with N as reference has numerator (U̇_A + U̇_B + U̇_C)/(Z_l + Z) = 0, so **U̇_{N'N} = 0** — with or without a neutral wire, and the neutral current is zero.
So connect N and N' by a short and draw phase A alone: U̇_A, Z_l and Z in series, İ_A = U̇_A/(Z_l + Z). The currents and voltages of phases B and C lag by 120° each — no need to compute them again.
The load phase voltages stay balanced, so the load line voltage = √3 × the load phase voltage (smaller than the source line voltage because of the drop on the lines).

ideas.title: 三角形（Δ）负载：线电流与相电流，Δ–Y 变换
text: Δ 负载每一相接在两根端线之间，承受的是**线电压**：İ_AB = U̇_AB/Z_Δ。线电流由结点 KCL 求：İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA。
对称时线电流是相电流的 √3 倍，并且**滞后**对应的相电流 30°：İ_A = √3İ_AB∠−30°。
端线上有阻抗时，Δ 负载两端的电压不再等于电源线电压。这时先把 Δ 负载等效成 Y：**Z_Y = Z_Δ/3**，按 Y–Y 一相计算求出线电流，再回到 Δ 负载：相电流 = 线电流/√3，超前 30°。

en.title: Delta (Δ) loads: line and phase currents, Δ–Y conversion
text: Each phase of a Δ load sits between two lines, so it sees the **line voltage**: İ_AB = U̇_AB/Z_Δ. The line currents follow from KCL at the nodes: İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA.
When balanced, the line current is √3 times the phase current and **lags** the corresponding phase current by 30°: İ_A = √3İ_AB∠−30°.

With impedance on the lines, the voltage across the Δ load is no longer the source line voltage. Convert the Δ load to an equivalent Y first, **Z_Y = Z_Δ/3**, find the line current by the one-phase Y–Y calculation, then go back to the Δ: phase current = line current/√3, leading by 30°.

ideas.title: 三相功率
text: 三相总有功功率等于三相之和。对称时 P = 3U_pI_p cos φ = √3U_lI_l cos φ，Y、Δ 两种接法都成立。
**φ 是每相负载的阻抗角**（相电压与相电流的相位差），不是线电压与线电流的夹角。无功 Q = √3U_lI_l sin φ，视在 S = √3U_lI_l。
也可以直接用元件算：每相电阻吸收 I_p²R，三相乘 3。对称三相电路的瞬时总功率是常数，这是三相制的一大优点。

en.title: Three-phase power
text: The total active power is the sum over the three phases. When balanced, P = 3U_pI_p cos φ = √3U_lI_l cos φ, for both Y and Δ loads.

**φ is the impedance angle of one phase of the load** (between phase voltage and phase current), not the angle between line voltage and line current. Reactive Q = √3U_lI_l sin φ, apparent S = √3U_lI_l.

You can also go element by element: each phase resistor absorbs I_p²R, times 3. The instantaneous total power of a balanced three-phase circuit is constant — one of the big advantages of three-phase systems.

ideas.title: 二瓦计法
text: 三相三线制中 İ_A + İ_B + İ_C = 0，所以两只功率表就能测总有功功率：W_1 的电流线圈串在 A 线、电压线圈接 A、C；W_2 的电流线圈串在 B 线、电压线圈接 B、C（公共线是 C）。P = W_1 + W_2——**对称、不对称负载都成立**。
功率表读数 = Re(电压线圈电压相量 × 电流线圈电流相量的共轭)：W_1 = Re(U̇_AC·İ_A*)，W_2 = Re(U̇_BC·İ_B*)。单只表的读数没有独立的物理意义，可以为负（φ > 60° 时 W_2 < 0）。
对称负载时 W_1 = U_lI_l cos(φ − 30°)，W_2 = U_lI_l cos(φ + 30°)，由两个读数可以反求 φ：tan φ = √3(W_1 − W_2)/(W_1 + W_2)。

en.title: The two-wattmeter method
text: In a three-wire system İ_A + İ_B + İ_C = 0, so two wattmeters measure the total active power: W_1 with its current coil in line A and voltage coil across A, C; W_2 with its current coil in line B and voltage coil across B, C (C is the common line). P = W_1 + W_2 — **for balanced and unbalanced loads alike**.

A wattmeter reads Re(voltage-coil phasor × conjugate of the current-coil phasor): W_1 = Re(U̇_AC·İ_A*), W_2 = Re(U̇_BC·İ_B*). A single reading has no physical meaning of its own and may be negative (W_2 < 0 when φ > 60°).
For a balanced load W_1 = U_lI_l cos(φ − 30°) and W_2 = U_lI_l cos(φ + 30°), so the two readings give φ back: tan φ = √3(W_1 − W_2)/(W_1 + W_2).

ideas.title: 不对称负载：中线的作用
text: 中线阻抗为零时 N' 与 N 等电位，三相**各自独立**：每相负载电压就是电源相电压，各相电流单独用欧姆定律求。
中线电流是三个相电流的**相量和** İ_N = İ_A + İ_B + İ_C。负载对称时为零；不对称时不为零，要用相量（代数形式）相加，不能把有效值直接相加。
所以照明等不对称负载必须用三相四线制，而且中线上不许装熔断器或开关。

en.title: Unbalanced loads: what the neutral wire does
text: With a zero-impedance neutral, N' and N are at the same potential and the three phases are **independent**: each load phase sees its source phase voltage, and each phase current follows from Ohm's law alone.
The neutral current is the **phasor sum** İ_N = İ_A + İ_B + İ_C. It is zero for a balanced load and nonzero otherwise; add the phasors (in rectangular form), never the rms values.
That is why unbalanced loads such as lighting need a four-wire system, with no fuse or switch in the neutral.

ideas.title: 无中线的不对称 Y 负载：中性点位移
text: 没有中线（或中线断开）时，N' 是一个独立结点。以 N 为参考，用弥尔曼定理：U̇_{N'N} = (U̇_AY_A + U̇_BY_B + U̇_CY_C)/(Y_A + Y_B + Y_C)。负载不对称时 U̇_{N'N} ≠ 0，称为**中性点位移**。
各相负载电压 = 电源相电压 − U̇_{N'N}，例如 U̇_{AN'} = U̇_A − U̇_{N'N}。位移使负载电压严重不对称：有的相欠压，有的相过压。
断相故障是它的特例：A 线断开后，B、C 两相负载串联接在线电压 U̇_BC 上。相序指示器则是利用中性点位移：电容接 A 相时，接 B 相的灯较亮。

en.title: Unbalanced Y load without neutral: neutral-point displacement
text: Without a neutral (or with it broken), N' is an independent node. With N as reference, Millman's theorem gives U̇_{N'N} = (U̇_AY_A + U̇_BY_B + U̇_CY_C)/(Y_A + Y_B + Y_C). For an unbalanced load U̇_{N'N} ≠ 0: the **neutral point is displaced**.
Each load phase voltage = source phase voltage − U̇_{N'N}, e.g. U̇_{AN'} = U̇_A − U̇_{N'N}. The displacement makes the load voltages badly unbalanced: some phases are under-, others over-voltage.

An open-phase fault is a special case: with line A broken, the loads of phases B and C are in series across the line voltage U̇_BC. A phase-sequence indicator exploits the displacement: with the capacitor on phase A, the lamp on phase B is the brighter one.

ideas.title: 不对称 Δ 负载
text: 电源对称、端线无阻抗时，不对称 Δ 负载的每一相仍然直接承受线电压：U̇_AB = √3U_p∠30°，U̇_BC = √3U_p∠−90°，U̇_CA = √3U_p∠150°。各相电流分别用欧姆定律求。
线电流用 KCL：İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA，İ_B = İ_BC − İ_AB，İ_C = İ_CA − İ_BC。不对称时**不能**用 √3 倍、30° 的关系。

en.title: Unbalanced Δ loads
text: With a balanced source and no line impedance, every phase of an unbalanced Δ load still sees a line voltage directly: U̇_AB = √3U_p∠30°, U̇_BC = √3U_p∠−90°, U̇_CA = √3U_p∠150°. Find each phase current with Ohm's law.
Line currents by KCL: İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA, İ_B = İ_BC − İ_AB, İ_C = İ_CA − İ_BC. The √3-and-30° relation does **not** apply when unbalanced.

en.title: Balanced Δ load: currents, power and the two wattmeters
en.statement: A balanced three-phase source (positive sequence, phase voltage U̇_A = 220∠0° V) feeds a balanced delta load, Z = 12 + j9 Ω per phase, with negligible line impedance. Power is measured with two wattmeters: W_1 has its current coil in line A and voltage coil across A, C; W_2 its current coil in line B and voltage coil across B, C. Find the load phase current, the line current, the total active power and the two readings.

results.ask: active power of one load phase P_AB

steps: 1. **A Δ load sees the line voltage.** U̇_AB = √3U̇_A∠30°: rms **381.05 V**, initial phase 30°.

3. **Line current.** Balanced Δ: İ_A = √3İ_AB∠−30°, rms √3 × 25.40 = **44.0 A**, initial phase **−36.87°** — differing from U̇_A by exactly the impedance angle, as the one-phase calculation with Z_Y = Z/3 = 4 + j3 Ω also gives.

4. **Three-phase power.** The resistance of one phase absorbs I_AB²·12 = 25.40² × 12 = **7744 W**; all three: P = 3 × 7744 = 23232 (W). Check with the formula √3U_lI_l cos φ = √3 × 381.05 × 44.0 × 0.8 — the same.

5. **Wattmeter readings.** φ = 36.87°: W_1 = U_lI_l cos(φ − 30°) = 381.05 × 44.0 × cos 6.87° = **16646 W**; W_2 = U_lI_l cos(φ + 30°) = **6586 W**. Their sum 16646 + 6586 = 23232 is the total power ✓.

en.title: Unbalanced Y load with the neutral broken
en.statement: A balanced three-phase source (positive sequence, U̇_A = 220∠0° V) feeds a star-connected resistive load: R_A = R_B = 10 Ω, R_C = 20 Ω. The neutral is broken and an ideal voltmeter V is connected between N' and N. Find the neutral-point displacement voltage U̇_{N'N} and the voltage and current of each load phase.
steps: 1. **N' is an independent node.** With N as reference, apply Millman's theorem to N'. Phase admittances: Y_A = Y_B = 1/10 S, Y_C = 1/20 S.
3. **Displacement voltage:** U̇_{N'N} = 11∠−60° / 0.25 = 44∠−60°: the voltmeter reads **44 V**, initial phase **−60°**.
4. **Load phase voltages** = source phase voltage − U̇_{N'N}:

**Conclusion:** with the neutral broken, phase C (the lightest load) is 20 % over-voltage and phases A, B are under-voltage. With an intact neutral U̇_{N'N} = 0, every phase gets 220 V, and the neutral current is 11∠−60° (A — the numerator of step 2).

mistakes.text: 把 √3U_lI_l cos φ 里的 φ 当成线电压与线电流的夹角。φ 是每相负载的阻抗角（相电压与相电流的夹角）；线电压与线电流之间还差着 30°。

en.text: Taking φ in √3U_lI_l cos φ as the angle between line voltage and line current. φ is the impedance angle of one load phase (phase voltage vs phase current); line voltage and line current differ by another 30°.

mistakes.text: 不对称负载也套用“线电流 = √3 × 相电流”“线电压超前 30°”。这些关系只对对称三相成立；不对称时一律用 KCL、KVL 做相量运算。

en.text: Using “line current = √3 × phase current” or “line voltage leads by 30°” for unbalanced loads. Those relations hold only when balanced; otherwise do phasor KCL/KVL.

mistakes.text: 中线电流或弥尔曼定理的分子把有效值直接相加（如 20 + 10 + 10）。三相电流相位差 120°，必须化成代数形式按相量相加。

en.text: Adding rms values directly for the neutral current or Millman's numerator (like 20 + 10 + 10). The three currents are 120° apart; add them as phasors in rectangular form.

mistakes.text: 没有中线、负载又不对称时，仍然认为每相负载电压是 220 V（或把 N' 当作接地）。这时必须先求中性点位移电压 U̇_{N'N}。

en.text: Assuming each load phase still gets 220 V (or that N' is grounded) when the load is unbalanced and there is no neutral. Find the displacement voltage U̇_{N'N} first.

mistakes.text: 端线有阻抗时仍把电源线电压直接加在 Δ 负载上。先 Δ→Y（Z_Δ/3），一相算出线电流，再换回 Δ 的相电流。

en.text: Putting the source line voltage straight across a Δ load when the lines have impedance. Convert Δ→Y (Z_Δ/3), find the line current from one phase, then return to the Δ phase current.

mistakes.text: 以为二瓦计法每只表读的是某一相的功率，或者读数不可能为负。两表之和才有意义；φ > 60° 时 W_2 为负，要把它的读数带负号相加。

en.text: Thinking each of the two wattmeters reads the power of one phase, or that a reading can't be negative. Only the sum is meaningful; for φ > 60° W_2 is negative and is added with its sign.
